title: Unpatterned Wafer Inspection - Delamination Detection on WaferSight PWG
subtitle: Post-Planarization Quality Validation for 7nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Anna Petrova

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the WaferSight PWG system to detect and classify Delamination defects during post-planarization inspection at the 7nm technology node. The test is conducted at Singapore Fab 7 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 200mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Delamination defects that are critical to yield at the 7nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the WaferSight PWG platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: WaferSight PWG
- Inspection Type: Unpatterned Wafer Inspection
- Target Defect: Delamination
- Process Step: Post-Planarization
- Wafer Size: 200mm
- Technology Node: 7nm
- Fab Location: Singapore Fab 7

This test case applies to all WaferSight PWG systems deployed at Singapore Fab 7 for post-planarization monitoring in the 7nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: WaferSight PWG
Software Version: v14.4.950
Recipe: UNPATTERNED_WAFER_INSPECTION_7nm_POST_PLANARIZATION
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: High (172 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 3mm
Sampling Plan: Full wafer sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the WaferSight PWG system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Unpatterned Wafer Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Delamination defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 7nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 48 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 92% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.1% for Unpatterned Wafer Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.93 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-10-31
Wafers Tested: 7
Total Defects Found: 1392
Defect Density: 443.09 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 0.5%
Capture Rate: 87.1%
Test Duration: 256 minutes
System Uptime: 96.5%

Result Classification: CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The WaferSight PWG demonstrated acceptable performance in detecting Delamination at the 7nm node.

b) The capture rate requires optimization of the detection algorithm.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) No significant drift was observed during the test duration.

e) The defect review station correlation was within specification.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
